projects.desc: A complete renovation of a 929-square-foot residence in Chicago’s John Hancock Center. An open plan, custom cabinetry, and updated finishes create a bright, composed home above the city.
notes: An open, light-filled plan
Large windows and an open layout draw the city and lake into the living space, making the most of a 929-square-foot footprint.
A more personal interior
Custom cabinetry, stainless steel appliances, and updated bathroom finishes bring a clean, contemporary character to the residence.

projects.desc: A 3,534-square-foot new home across three levels. Vaulted ceilings, an open kitchen, and carefully planned living spaces bring a sense of light and ease to this Highland Park residence.
notes: Space across three levels
The 3,534-square-foot home combines open living areas with three bedrooms and 3.5 bathrooms, offering room for both gathering and retreat.
Details that support daily life
White maple cabinetry and quartz countertops anchor the kitchen. A second-floor laundry, mudroom storage, and heated garage add everyday practicality.

projects.desc: A 5,248-square-foot custom residence with five bedrooms and generous spaces for gathering. Custom cabinetry, quartzite surfaces, and a full-height stone fireplace give the home its distinctive character.
notes: Room to gather
The kitchen connects to a family room with an 11-foot ceiling and a full-height stone fireplace. A butler’s pantry links the formal dining and living areas.
A quieter side of the home
A primary suite with a marble bath, walk-in steam shower, and dual closets balances the generous entertaining spaces and finished lower level.

projects.desc: A Glenview residence with distinctive gabled architecture, contrasting exterior materials, and bright, connected interiors. The kitchen and gathering spaces bring a contemporary sense of openness to the home.
notes: Architectural character
The gabled exterior, contrasting materials, and large windows give this Glenview home a distinct presence.
Connected interiors
The project photography reveals bright living spaces and a kitchen organized around an island, with cabinetry and finishes carried consistently through the room.

The masonry exterior and arched entry establish the character of the home before the interior unfolds.
Everyday gathering spaces
An open kitchen and living area, a central island, and a detailed staircase shape the interior shown in the project gallery.

See the home in detail

projects.desc: A Downers Grove townhome with a strong street presence and open living spaces. Large windows, continuous wood floors, and a kitchen centered on an island give the interior a bright, connected feel.
notes: An urban approach to townhome living
A structured façade and generous windows create a distinctive street presence for this Downers Grove project.
A connected interior
The photographed kitchen, dining, and living areas share an open arrangement, with wood floors and a central island tying the spaces together.

faq: What types of projects can we discuss?

Gold Coast Build handles residential and commercial construction, including new homes, renovations, condominium remodeling, commercial spaces, and build-outs. Share the property and scope you have in mind so we can discuss the right starting point.
Do I need complete plans before contacting you?
You can start a conversation at the idea stage or bring an existing set of drawings. Let us know what has already been decided and where you would like help moving the project forward.
What should I prepare for the first conversation?

Your project address, a short description of the work, any plans or photographs, your timing preferences, and an initial budget range are useful. If some of these are still open, simply tell us where you are in the process.
How are budget and timing discussed?

Both depend on the property, the extent of work, the level of finish, and the project’s specific constraints. The first step is to understand those factors so the discussion is grounded in your actual scope.
Gold Coast Build works across Chicago and the surrounding suburbs. Our project portfolio includes the North Shore and western suburbs. Contact us with your project location to discuss coverage.
